messages:
alex: Quick holiday thing 1010 who's up for a 'cozy corner' photo drop? mugs, fairy lights, pets, whatever.
riley: I'm in. Will include my cat who insists on sitting in any mug-shaped container.
ops-bot: FYI: Free spiced cider in kitchen at 4pm today. :apple:
marta: Love this. Can we make a goofy award list? 'Most twinkly', 'Best pet cameo', 'Most suspiciously lit ficus'.
drew: +1 to suspicious ficus. Also offering to bring a small box of tea bags.
alex: OK rules: post a photo here by Sunday 10am. We'll vote with emoji reactions Monday. No editing, candid snaps encouraged.
riley: I have a string of tiny paper stars that look surprisingly professional when photographed close up.
marta: Will bring some tiny battery tea lights. Also gluten-free biscotti.
drew: Who's on mug duty? My cupboards are sad.
alex: riley can bring 4 mugs, I can bring 3 vintage ones.
ops-bot: @people-ops note: informal gathering estimated 8-12 people. No catering needed.
marta: Winner gets a digital sticker and eternal office bragging rights.
riley: game on. See you at cider hour!
